<b>Bugs of Pharloom</b> is a [[Unique Wishes|Unique Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, started by talking to [[Nuu]] in the [[Halfway Home]].

== Wish ==
Nuu grants [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] the [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]], and asks Hornet to defeat 100 enemies, recording information about them in the Journal. It is only required to defeat enemies once; the additional Notes after defeating enough of them are not necessary.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Hunter's Journal.png!Nuu's location in the Halfway Home
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Tool Pouch Upgrade.png|link=Tool Pouch|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After completing the Wish, Nuu is overjoyed by the beastly "essences" lingering on Hornet and attempts to suck said “essences” from her, but is quickly rebuffed with a slap. Nuu then adds a pocket to the [[Tool Pouch]], allowing the storage of more {{S|[[Shell Shards]]}} and {{CrestSlot|Red|s}}.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Nuu release trailer.png!"Such behaviour is unfriendly."
}}
